feature_descriptions.moid: Minimum Orbit Intersection Distance to Earth (AU) - strongest orbital collision criterion
feature_descriptions.H: Absolute magnitude (mag) - inversely proportional to physical asteroid size
feature_descriptions.collision_prob_factor: Geometrical collision proxy factor based on inclination, MOID, and orbit size
feature_descriptions.kinetic_energy_mt: Estimated potential impact kinetic energy in Megatons of TNT
feature_descriptions.relative_velocity_kms: Öpik-calculated encounter velocity relative to Earth (km/s)
feature_descriptions.q: Perihelion distance (AU) - closest orbital approach to Sun
feature_descriptions.a: Semi-major axis (AU) - mean distance to Sun
feature_descriptions.e: Orbital eccentricity - how stretched the ellipse is
feature_descriptions.i: Orbital inclination (degrees) - angle relative to Earth's orbital plane
